units.source_text: “抚物”是祓禊时所用的纸人纸衣。

en.t: Nademono were paper human figures and paper garments used during ritual purification.

units.source_text: 祓终，以此拂拭身体后投入河中，意思是拂去灾殃。

en.t: When the purification rite ended, people wiped their bodies with these objects and then threw them into the river, meaning to brush away misfortune.
